title: Ye ghazi alamdar
body:
Ye ghazi alamdar
Jab karwaan karbobala lot ke ayaa. Kulsum ne mehmil ke jo parde ko hataaya. (Dil thaam ke ye kafle waalo ko bataayaa) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Farshe azaa shabbir ke matam ka bichaawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis sher ke shano pe hame naaz tha har dam. Bacho ke liye aas tha jis sher ka parcham (Parcham mere abbas ka is ban me sajawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Awaaz dekar dashte mein baba ko bulawo. Bhabhi kaha ho matame akbar kare awo (Majlis ke liye fatema zehra ko sadaa do) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Un bekaso pe rona jinhe pyaas ne mara. Wo aun-o-muhammad bhi hai shabbir pe wara (Un bekaso ki pyaas bhi ashko se bujaado) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai sab hi shahadat se dhani haq ke musafir. Wo awsaja wo john o habib ibn mazahir (Chehlum har ik mazloom ka karbal me manawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo saamne dekho to hai behta huwa darya. Lekin labe darya nahi ab foj ka pehra (Jee khol ke ab pani piyo sab ko pilawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham aagaye zindaan se magar qayd hai dukhtar. Ammu ko bulati rahi din rat jo ro kar (Zindaan se masoom sakina ko bulawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab aurte bazaare jafaa me rahi purgham. Bechadere ke karb se karti rahi matam (Behaal hai sab unse kaho sar ko chupaawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai dhoop ke maidan me mere be zubaan asghar. Saye me nahi jaa saki is dard se madar (Ik sayeba ab turbate asghar pe banawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Farwa kahaa hai unse kaho aaj to paiham. Jee bharke karo qasime dilgir ka matam (Ik raat ke noshaah ki dulhan ko bataa do) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar pite ke rote hai sare markade shabbir. Sajjad hai nawha kuna or zainabe dilgir (Dil khol ke rone do inhe chup na karawo) x2
<<MINI>>
(Ye ghazi alamdar ki jagir he logo) x2
